newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: US UNIT PRESSURES SMIT TRAFO 1995 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: US UNIT PRESSURES SMIT TRAFO 1995 RESULTS.

text.p: Dutch transformer maker Smit Transformatoren NV said on Tuesday it had decided to cease activities at its American Charleston unit, due to persistent losses.
It said the stake in Charleston had been written down, as of the end of December 1995, by its estimated direct sales value. It said the write down had been booked entirely in 1995.
"The sales efforts on the American market will continue undiminished," it added in a statement.
Smit Trafo booked a loss of 47.1 million guilders in the full-year 1995, and said it also expected to make a loss in 1996. It posted a first half 1996 net profit of 1.5 million guilders.
